note: Portable default protected chrome regions for UC San Diego Decorator 5. Selectors only — no ids or content specific to any one site — so this holds for any Decorator project. The canvas selector is not here: it is read from decorator-kit.json, since it varies by project shape (main#main-content vs div#ag-app-canvas per the Antigravity Code Kit) while these regions do not. Add project-specific regions in chrome-regions.local.json (same shape, entries merge by id). Validate against contracts/chrome-regions.schema.json. Derived from skills/ucsd-decorator/references/canvas-contract.md and protected-regions.md.
